methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Explicitly identifies data centers as increasing Virginia's urban-rural divide, signaling concentration of infrastructure and economic benefits in metro areas while rural regions lack access to the wealth and capability being generated.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership represents institutional commitment to distributed AI education and community impact beyond elite tech corridors, potentially building deeper capabilities across Richmond's diverse population base.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals grassroots capacity-building in historically underserved Appalachian region, testing whether distributed deep learning can emerge outside traditional tech hubs.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce suggests the region is experiencing capability demands from concentrated AI infrastructure, but framed as pressure rather than opportunity indicates potential shallow adoption rather than deep skill development.

signals.title: State invests $3M to help transform Hampton Roads into hub for aircraft technology and training - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: $3M state investment in Hampton Roads aircraft technology hub demonstrates intentional concentration of advanced technical capability in military-maritime region, deepening specialized expertise but not distributing broadly across Virginia.
